_what: The one-time passkey link and the passkey it adds (read-data/withdraw-passkey-link.mjs): how long a link works, the words and statuses of making it, using it and refusing a passkey, and the path it opens. Ported from the earlier code base's account/passkeys/link route, makePasskeyLink, the passkey finish in src/worker.mjs and refusePasskeyStep (b6ae0ebf815f). The earlier code had no route that withdraws a link before it is used or runs out; a link only ends by use or by its time. An unsaved passkey is named back to the device through forget_passkey. The link's storage, its hashing and the random code are the caller's.
